messages:
AJ (pm): Silverbell just dropped SBX2 driver v0.9.2-rc1 under NDA. They included a test image and a short changelog. We need a quick EAP run plan: perf harness, telemetry hooks, and a safe way to surface regressions internally. TL;DR: they say +18% token/sec on our 8k window model in their lab.
Jonathan (platform): copy. I'll schedule a small pool in hw-eap-cluster and run our standard throughput + latency profiles. Can someone paste the modprobe flags?
Silverbell Eng: hi all — driver uses new iommu path; recommended modprobe: "sbx2_core io_coalesce=1 prefetch=0x2". Symbol map and signed module in the S3 link I posted to the NDA folder. Note: please don't snapshot vendor logs outside the NDA bucket.
Sarah (ml-infra): thanks. I'll use the WIP bench script. Plan to run: 3x throughput (batch sizes 1/4/8), 3x p95 latency tests, and memory/kvcache stability for a 6-hour run. Command I'll run:
```
./run_bench --model redwood/gpt-8k --driver /opt/sbx2/sbx2.ko --seq 8192 --workers 8 --warmup 300
```
Jonathan (platform): deploy-bot, please provision 4 nodes with SBX2 and k8s nodepool label sbx2:eap.
deploy-bot: Provisioning request accepted: 4 nodes queued -> hw-eap-sbx2-pool-42. ETA ~12m.
Elaine (partnerships): Quick reminder: per NDA we can't publish raw numbers or screenshots. We should capture anonymized metrics and a one-paragraph summary if we go public. Also ask Silverbell for repro steps for any kernel oops we see.
Silverbell Eng: agreed on NDA. We'll provide repro flows for any crash dumps you share to the NDA bucket. Also we're happy to turn on extra ringbuffer logging for a short window if you want deeper traces — let us know timeframe.
Sarah (ml-infra): If ringbuffer logging is on, perf counters will spike and affect baseline. Proposal: baseline run without ringbuffer, then a second run with ringbuffer for 10 mins to capture edge behavior.
AJ (pm): good plan. Timeline: baseline runs today, ringbuffer short capture tomorrow morning, then a short sync Thurs with Silverbell to review anomalies. Elaine — can you confirm stakeholder invites (sales, legal, docs)?
Elaine (partnerships): I'll send invites to sales (ops-sales), legal (legal-ccc), and docs. Also adding a secure calendar invite with the NDA link and the S3 path. :thumbsup:
Jonathan (platform): nodes ready. kickoff in 6m. I'll post logs to NDA bucket and a sanitized summary here once runs complete. :eyes:
Silverbell Eng: thanks — we'll standby and ingest the anonymized logs. happy to join the sync if you hit any reproducible perf cliffs.
